identification: SAMAP Moulin a Cereales Manuel (SAMAP manual stone grain mill), made in France by SAMAP, Horbourg-Wihr, Colmar. Grey/white composite-stone burr housing with steel crank arm and cream knob/handle. Stripped: no hopper, clamp or bench base visible; rusted crank, rust spots and chips to the housing, peeling label. Armitage estimate 20-40, current bid $10 at time of viewing.
